people-w1-skip-deleted.ref: statenour/people-w1-skip-deleted (job 2026-10-30-people-tracker): apply hardening before --execute, from the author's self-review on #3427, the manager's static second reader (silent-failure-hunter at 18c5031da9) and Codex on #3435. (a) Soft-deleted people: recordInteraction readPrior treats deletedAt as not found, and writeRow's counter update is pinned to { id, deletedAt: null } inside the write transaction, P2025 -> PersonNotFoundError, so a delete that commits between read and write rolls the ledger row back (Codex P2: atomic with the write); insertWithinWindow also skips via a required personLive check. (b) No swallowed reasons: runApply failures are { key, error } (ids and the message only) and the status is applied_with_failures when any row failed; the plan loop's failed digest carries its reason and the partial line names the first one. (c) Backup: backupInOneSnapshot runs CREATE TABLE AS plus both counts in one transaction opened REPEATABLE READ, refuses 0 source rows or a mismatch by rolling the copy back (the next run is not blocked), and turns an existing backup (42P07) into the exact rerun step; the script prints the first failure and the rerun step. (d) Nits: the plan file is read before the Prisma import (a missing file fails with ENOENT before any connection, run locally); the progress file is written before the first model call; the header says the digest still touches the DB per call. Red first for every item. 17 files using recordInteraction or the backfill, 262 tests; the 4 core files 54 tests under TZ=UTC and America/New_York; app tsc and the scoped script tsc exit 0.
